messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing sustained NVMe IOPS saturation on gnode-eu-42 during the nightly cleaner window, GPU attaches are timing out (~12m queue).
infra-bot: Alert: nvme_iops_high on gnode-eu-42 at 00:12 UTC. avg_iops=210k, avg_iowait=68%.
dylan: Is this the same cleaner window we shifted last week?
maria: Yep. Cleaner + large checkpoint GC overlaps the batch job window (23:30-01:00). Janitor spawns lots of deletes and fsyncs -> write storm. Quick tail from the node:
```
Jan 03 00:10:23 janitor[3145]: queued delete 128k entries
Jan 03 00:10:24 kernel: blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 123456789
Jan 03 00:11:05 janitor[3145]: running concurrency=8
```
kai: Options: throttle janitor concurrency, move cleaner window, or increase local-ssd pool for GPU attaches. Short-term we can cap janitor to 2 on the canary. Longer-term we should add a scheduling policy.
leah: Cost tradeoff note — extending the cleaner window pushes cleanup delay but avoids GPU attach failures that block customer jobs. We measured ~12m extra queue per attach yesterday which translates to noticeable SLA blips and ~$0.15/min per stuck GPU for critical queues.
dylan: Quick mitigation: flip `janitor.concurrent=2` via remote-config/ssm on the problematic gnode pool and roll canary. I can push the change.
maria: Go for it. Patching canary now.
infra-bot: Deploybot: patch `janitor.concurrent=2` applied to gnode-eu-42 (canary) at 00:20 UTC.
maria: Canary metrics: IOPS down ~60% within 3m, iowait back to ~18%, GPU attaches resumed. :thumbsup:
kai: Nice. We still need automation — proposal: if `gpu_attach_queue > 5` OR `gpu_attach_latency > 120s` then automatically scale janitor down or pause background cleaners for that pool.
leah: +1. Also add a cost alarm that ties GPU queue time to an alert so SRE/product can triage before customers notice.
dylan: Created INF-7423 to capture runbook + automatic throttle policy + followup to evaluate moving heavy deletes to low-priority worker. (cc @maria @kai)
maria: Thanks — will monitor the canary for the next 24h. If stable, roll the config to the rest of eu-west. Marking this thread resolved unless it recurs.
